spots.name: Khan's Palace

hours.note: Closed Mon; Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Khan's Palace is located in the town of Bakhchysarai, Crimea. It was built in the 16th century and became home to a succession of Crimean Khans. The walled enclosure contains a mosque, a harem, a cemetery, living quarters and gardens.

spots.name: Chufut-Kale
spots.summary: Chufut-Kale is a medieval city-fortress in the Crimean Mountains that now lies in ruins. It is a national monument of Crimean Karaites culture just 3 km (1.9 mi) east of Bakhchysarai.

Bakhchysarai Cave Monastery

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Dormition Monastery of the Caves, otherwise known as Bakhchysarai Cave Monastery, or Uspensky Cave Monastery is located in Crimea, near the town of Bakhchysarai. It is a cave monastery carved out of a cliff, thought to have been founded in the 8th century.

spots.name: Big Khan Mosque

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Big Khan Mosque is located in Bakhchysarai, Crimea, and is part of the Bakhchysarai Palace. It is one of the largest mosques in Crimea and one of the first buildings of the Khan's Palace. The mosque was built in 1532 by Sahib I Giray and bore his name in the 17th century.

spots.summary: Zincirli Madrasa is a madrasa, built of stone by Meñli I Giray in 1500 near Bakhchysarai, Crimea.

spots.name: Tepe-Kermen

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Tepe-Kermen is a butte and an archeological site of an early medieval fortified settlement in the Bakhchysarai Raion of Crimea. It is located seven km southeast of Bakhchysarai, and two km northeast of the Kyz-Kermen hillfort. Its height is 544 meters. The easiest way to climb the mountain is from the northern slope.

spots.name: Eski Dürbe
spots.summary: Eski Dürbe is the oldest türbe in the town of Bakhchysarai, Crimea, Ukraine. According to some sources, Eski Dürbe was built in the 14th century, over 100 years before the Khan's Palace. The tomb is located on the left bank of the river Çürük Suv, 180m south-east of the Khan's Palace.

spots.name: Ресторан «Каминный зал»
spots.summary: В интерьере смешение стилей изысканного ресторана и бара из девяностых, но в целом, если не придираться, то неплохо. Это одно из самых дешёвых заведений в городе, при чём, что это никак не сказывается на качестве еды, и она оказывается лучше большинства других заведений. Большое меню, в основном это русско-украинская кухня с добавлением нескольких крымско-татарских блюд. Из минусов - чтобы добрать

spots.name: Le Kafe «Пушкинъ»

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Пожалуй, самый неплохой ресторан в городе, зимой здесь зажигают камин, летом открыта летняя площадка. Из еды предлагают блюда крымскотатарской, европейской и японской кухонь. Качество японской неизвестно, а вропейской и крымско-татарской вполне на уровне. Особенно вкусные янтыки. По стоимости выходит дороже, чем в среднем по Бахчисараю, но и еда значительно лучше.
